responsibility: Implements low-level LONGREAL parsing and format analysis. It owns the finite-state scanner for signed fixed and scientific notation, maps input text to ConvTypes classifications, converts validated strings with strtold, raises module-specific exceptions for invalid or out-of-range values, and computes formatted output lengths by reusing ConvStringLong renderers, making it the parsing/validation core behind LongStr and LongIO.
same_name_distinction: This .mod file is the working conversion engine: it implements the finite-state scanner, validates formats, converts with strtold, computes formatted lengths via ConvStringLong, and allocates/raises the module-specific exception source, whereas LongConv.def only publishes those services.
